name: context-menu
useFor: Use as a shortcut to actions on the thing under the pointer (a thread in a list, a file in a tree). Wrap that area in ContextMenuTrigger and build the panel with the same parts as Dropdown Menu. Every action in it must also be reachable another way, usually a dropdown menu on the same row.
constraints: The only way to reach an action
A styled trigger area that looks like a button
source: Extrapolated from the Hoplite website's popups (the header nav's sheet and rows, .hn__sheet and .hn__item); the site has no context menu.

examples.content: "use client"; import * as React from "react"; import { ArrowClockwiseIcon, CopyIcon, GitPullRequestIcon, PencilSimpleIcon, PushPinIcon, TrashIcon } from "@phosphor-icons/react/ssr"; import { ContextMenu, ContextMenuCheckboxItem, ContextMenuContent, ContextMenuGroup, ContextMenuItem, ContextMenuLabel, ContextMenuRadioGroup, ContextMenuRadioItem, ContextMenuSeparator, ContextMenuShortcut, ContextMenuSub, ContextMenuSubContent, ContextMenuSubTrigger, ContextMenuTrigger, } from "@/components/ui/context-menu"; export function Preview() { return ( Fix flaky upload test Right-click, or press and hold, for actions Rename ⌘R Copy thread link ⌘L Rerun checks Open pull request As draft Ready for review Delete thread ); } export function Options() { const [pinned, setPinned] = React.useState(true); const [notify, setNotify] = React.useState(false); const [agent, setAgent] = React.useState("claude"); return ( Right-click the thread list Thread Pinned Notify when done setAgent(String(value))}> Agent Claude Code Codex Cursor ); }

title: Context Menu
description: The dropdown menu's panel opened at the pointer by a right click or a long press: a square ground panel with a quiet hairline and a long soft cast, 36px rows in the hover wash under the pointer, Kode Mono shortcuts, checks and hexagon marks on chosen rows, destructive rows in the orange.
